title: SMYLS Multi-site Trial
official: Self-Management for Youth Living With Sickle Cell Disease: SMYLS Multi-site Trial
summary: The purpose of this study is to find out whether a web-based intervention using a mobile app is helpful for teens and young adults with sickle cell disease (SCD) in learning how to care for and manage their symptoms.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* documentation in the electronic health record of any type of SCD
* owns mobile device compatible with the intervention
* access to the internet

Exclusion Criteria:

* Plans to relocate outside of study site area in the next 12 months
* Plans to transition to adult care in 12 months or less
* Parent/caregiver or provider report of neurocognitive impairment that precludes ability to use intervention and participate in study
* non-English speaking
